items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secret handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Compliance is only a technical baseline: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, medium for bounded changes adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged, continue bounded read-only evidence capture, and permit only qualifying ordinary reversible growth. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, deploy, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture and preserve unknown controls as unknown. No security-sensitive launch, credentials, permissions, configuration, dependencies, data collection, deployment, or external outreach is authorized.
